crossroads_sleepguard_1.m: Hello there. Can I help you?
r: Mind if I use one of the beds over there?

crossroads_sleepguard_2.m: Hello again. I hope the bed is comfortable enough. Use it as much as you like.

crossroads_sleepguard_4.m: No, sorry. These beds are for guards and allies of Feygard only.

crossroads_sleepguard_5.m: Say, aren't you that kid that helped the guards down in Fallhaven? With the thieves that were planning an escape?
r: Yes, I helped the guards in the prison find out about some plans that the thieves had.

crossroads_sleepguard_6.m: I knew I had heard about you somewhere. You are always welcome by us guards. You can use that second bed over there to the left if you need to rest.

farrik.10: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me of a plan to help a fellow thief escape from the Fallhaven jail.
farrik.20: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me the details of the plan, and I accepted the task of helping him. The guard captain apparently has a drinking problem. The plan is that I get a prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild that will knock out the guard captain in the jail. I might be required to bribe the guard captain.
farrik.25: I got the prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.30: I told Farrik that I don't fully agree with their plan. I might tell the guard captain about their shady plan.
farrik.32: I have given the prepared mead to the guard captain.
farrik.40: I have told the guard captain of the plan that the thieves have to release their friend.
farrik.50: The guard captain wants me to tell the thieves that the security will be lowered for tonight. We might be able to catch some of the thieves.
farrik.60: I managed to bribe the guard captain into drinking the prepared mead. He should be out during the night allowing the thieves to break their friend free.
farrik.70: Farrik rewarded me for helping the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.80: I have told Farrik that the security will be lowered tonight.
farrik.90: The guard captain thanked me for helping him plan to catch the thieves. He said he will also tell other guards that I helped him.
